# ZBar QR decoder

This directory vendors the QR-only subset of ZBar 0.23.93 from
https://github.com/mchehab/zbar at commit
`bb05ec54eec57f8397cb13fb9161372a281a1219`.

The iOS configuration is restricted to QR Code support. The upstream
copyright and component notices are preserved in `COPYING`; the full LGPL 2.1
text is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.
